note:
R22 — structural bound of the gen7 context bytecode `audio/context/pbp_eng_contextgasscript.gas` (`CSIS`): header and blob table only.
Observed (PS3 / Xbox 360 NHL 14 / 15 / Legacy): `u32 0 | u32 2 | u16 3, u16 1 | 'CSIS' | u32 0 | 'CSS_' | u32 0x1c | u32 1 | u32 0 | u32 count |
(count + 1) x u32 offset (sorted; offset[0] == table end)`; blob k (k = 1..count) spans offset[k] .. offset[k+1] (the last to EOF); every
non-empty blob begins `u32 id (== k) | u32 0 | u32 0 | u32 1 | u32 ptr | ...`. Blobs carry no identifier strings. Instruction semantics,
the blob -> context binding and runtime firing are NOT decoded. Read-only. Usage: python r22_gas_sections.py <out.json>
